title: jumbled dense saudi-arabian sesame flatbread
description: a kid-friendly saudi-arabian dish made with sesame butter and a sweet glaze, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: in a large mixing bowl, combine sesame butter and yogurt, stirring until smooth.
add flour and mix until a dough forms.
knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 1 hour.
roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
place the dough on a slate tile or baking sheet, topping with black sesame seeds.
bake for 18 minutes, or until golden brown.
while the flatbread is baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together 1/4 cup of honey and 1/4 cup of water in a small bowl.
once the flatbread is done, brush the glaze all over the top of the bread.
let the flatbread cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
